facts.fact: The Anexo Informativo tabled with the 2024 budget bill (receitas consignadas, framework law 55/IX/2019 art. 36 h) assigns the operators' contribution and the radio-spectrum charge to the universal-service fund FUSI, with counterpart spending of CVE 122,073,633 for 2024, a proposed-stage figure not reprinted in the enacted law.
facts.system: Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)

note: FUSI figure is proposed-stage for 2024; the document does not name the decree setting up the fund; SNIAC (identity fee) and Casa do Cidadão (service fee) are earmarked fees for other systems and give no fact.
